newsitem.title: USA: Templeton Vietnam amends investment policy.
newsitem.headline: Templeton Vietnam amends investment policy.

text.p: Templeton Vietnam Opportunities Fund Inc, a closed-end investment company, said on Tuesday that shareholders approved deleting the fund's restriction on loans and adopted a new lending policy.
The fund's fundamental investment restriction concerning real estate investments was also amended, the fund said.
The fund's lead portfolio manager is J. Mark Mobius and its investment advisor is Templeton Asset Management Ltd.
The aim of the changes was to give the fund greater flexibility while investing in Vietnam, it said.
The fund is designed for investors seeking long-term capital appreciation through equity investments in Vietnam and Vietnam-related companies.
